دَافِنُ أَمْرٍ , in the K, erroneously, دَافِنَآء, (TA,) (tropical:) The inward, or intrinsic, state or circumstances of a case or an affair. (K, TA.) ―
-b2- بَقَرَةٌ دَافِنَةُ الجَذْمِ A cow, or an animal of the ox-kind, whose أَضْرَاس [i. e. teeth, or molar teeth,] are ground, or worn, by reason of extreme age. (S, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
